societies.name: Hermetic Order
societies.description: Unlocks Ley Lines that provide Science and Culture from adjacent districts
societies.initiate: Unlocks Ley Lines: +2 Science, +1 Culture from unimproved tiles
societies.adept: Ley Lines now provide +4 Science, +2 Culture
societies.master: Ley Lines provide +6 Science, +4 Culture. Great Scientists provide +2 extra Science

societies.name: Owls of Minerva
societies.description: Extra trade routes, envoy bonuses, and Gold from trade
societies.initiate: +1 Trade Route capacity, +1 Envoy when sending a first Trade Route to a City-State
societies.adept: +2 Trade Route capacity, +2 Gold from all Trade Routes
societies.master: +2 additional Trade Route capacity, +5 Gold from international Trade Routes, Economic policies are wildcard policies
uniques: [+1] Trade Route capacity <for [Owls of Minerva] initiates>
Gain [1] Envoys per turn <for [Owls of Minerva] initiates>
[+2] Trade Route capacity <for [Owls of Minerva] adepts>
[+2] Trade Route capacity <for [Owls of Minerva] masters>
[+5] [Gold] from [International] Trade Routes <for [Owls of Minerva] masters>
Economic policies are wildcard policies <for [Owls of Minerva] masters>

societies.name: Sanguine Pact
societies.description: Vampire units that grow stronger with each kill, Governor manipulation
societies.initiate: Unlocks the Vampire unit, which gains +3 Strength per kill
societies.adept: Vampire units gain +5 Strength per kill, +1 Movement
societies.master: Vampire units gain +7 Strength per kill, can move after attacking. Governors can be assigned to enemy cities
uniques: Can move after attacking <for [Vampire] units> <for [Sanguine Pact] masters>
May assign [Governor] to [Enemy] cities <for [Sanguine Pact] masters>

societies.name: Void Singers
societies.description: Faith and Culture from Old God Obelisks, Relics bonus
societies.initiate: All cities with a Monument gain an Old God Obelisk: +4 Faith, +2 Culture
societies.adept: Old God Obelisks provide +8 Faith, +4 Culture. Relics yield +2 Faith and +2 Culture
societies.master: Old God Obelisks provide +12 Faith, +6 Culture. +50% Faith to Culture conversion. Great Works of Writing yield +4 Faith
uniques: [+4] [Faith] from [Great Work of Writing] <for [Void Singers] masters>
